blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Agatha Wong missed the Asian Games 2026 podium anew after settling for 10th place in the women’s taijiquan and tajijian final on Sunday at Aichi Prefectural Martial Arts Hall in Japan. The 28-year-old wushu national team star finished with a total of 18.859 points in both events. Wong opened her campaign at seventh in the tajiquan portion with a score of 9.703.
